name: Haris
status: AI assistant · not an official body
welcome:
Hi, I'm Haris. I help you spot online scams, and guide you if you have been a victim.

I don't store your messages, and I hide your personal details before analysing them.
adAsk: Paste the ad's text or link as it is, with the advertiser's number or account if there is one, or attach a screenshot of the ad. I'll check it first.
adImageNotRead: I couldn't read the screenshot right now. Please paste the ad's text or link.
adWhere: Where did you see this ad?
adPaid: Did you pay the advertiser anything, a deposit or otherwise?
adToReport: Let's prepare a full report for the authority, with the ad in it. If you paid by card, call your bank now.
adStory:
I saw an ad on {platform} and paid the advertiser. The ad:
{ad}
askCheck: Paste the message, link or offer you received and I'll check it.
siteClean: Nothing found on the page itself
redacted: I hid {n} piece(s) of your personal data before analysis.
qType: Let's prepare your report. What happened?
qWhen: When did it happen? Pick one, or type the time.
qDesc: Describe what happened in your own words: who contacted you, what they asked for, what you did.
qAmount: Did you lose money? Type the amount, or choose 'None'.
qIds: Type the scammer's numbers, links or accounts, one per line.
qEvidence: What evidence do you have? (screenshots, transfer receipt, messages, call log)
qSteps: What have you done so far?
needDesc: I need a short description of what happened for the report to be useful.
reportReady:
Your report is ready. Reference: {ref}

File it with the police through Aman or eCrime, and attach your screenshots.
found: I found these details in your description and added them:
qStory: Tell me what happened, your way: type it, tap the microphone and speak, or attach screenshots of the chat or the debit alert. The more you share, the fewer questions I'll ask.
qStoryMore: Add anything else: text, speech or screenshots.
imagesRead: I read your screenshots and added what I found to the report.
imagesNotRead: I attached your screenshots to the file as evidence. Reading what they show needs the AI to be switched on.
urgentBank: If you haven't yet: call your bank now on the number on the back of your card and ask them to block it. Every minute counts.
summaryHint: Check the details. Tap Edit next to any line to correct it.
micNote: Your browser's dictation turns your speech into text. Haris then checks it and suggests fixes for words that were probably misheard. Check the text before you send it.
dialectQ: Which accent will you speak in? Choosing it helps dictation understand you better.
dialectSet: Accent: {name}. You can change it any time.
polished: I checked the text. These words were probably misheard:
polishNote: Numbers, phone numbers and links are never changed.
fixedUsed: Done. The corrected text is in the message box: check it, then send.
reportConsent: This goes to the campaign radar: the sender's number and link, and the message text with any personal details removed. Nothing about you is sent.
reportThanksFirst: Thank you, your report arrived. You are the first to report this message.
reportThanks: Thank you, your report arrived. {n} people have reported this campaign so far.
reportEscalated: Reports have reached the level where the authority is alerted to review it.
reportConfirmed: The authority has confirmed this campaign and issued an official warning.
radarAsk: Paste the message you got and I'll send it to the campaign radar, so the campaign is spotted if others get it too.
guide: Paste any suspicious message or link. Haris tells you how risky it is, why, and what to do.
If something happened: follow the plan
Pick your situation, such as 'I paid' or 'My account was hacked', for immediate steps in order and the official reporting numbers.
To report: tell it your way
Type, speak in your own accent, or attach screenshots. Haris asks only for what's missing, then prepares the report for you to give the police.
guideCommunity: Protect others: if you get a scam message and don't respond, tap 'Report it to protect others'. Every report helps spot the campaign early, so the authority can approve a warning that reaches everyone.
guidePrivacy: Haris doesn't keep your chats or personal details. It is an assistant, not an official body.
micError: Couldn't start the microphone. Allow the browser to use it, or type instead.
maxImages: You can attach up to 3 images at a time.
error: Could not reach the server. Please try again.
tooMany: Too many requests. Please wait a minute.
qEmirate: Which emirate do you live in? The report goes to the authority there.
authConsent: Everything in the report file will be sent to the authority, except the screenshots: they stay with you, and the authority may ask for them later. The report is kept for {days} days only, then deleted automatically. Before sending, we confirm your identity with your digital ID.
uaePass: Confirm my identity with UAE PASS
uaePassDemo: Demo: the UAE PASS step here is simulated, and the report does not reach any real authority.
sentAuthority: Your report {ref} was sent to the authority in {emirate}. Status: {status}.
trackHint: Follow it from "My reports" in the menu. Only the report number is kept on this device.
noReports: You haven't sent a report from this device.
qAddInfo: Type the information asked for, then send it.
caseGone: A report no longer exists: it was deleted after the retention period.
infoWaiting:
🛡️ I got a question from the authority about your report {ref}:
“{note}”

Type your answer here and I'll pass it to them.
newsReceived: ✅ The authority received your report {ref}. It is now under review.
newsClosedNote:
Your report {ref} was closed, with this note from the authority:
“{note}”
authoritySafety: 🔒 The authority will never ask you for a verification code, a password or a card number.
residencyQ: Do you live in the UAE, or are you visiting?
qStaying: Which emirate are you staying in now? The report goes to the authority there.
departureQ: When do you leave the UAE? If you fly soon, your report moves up the queue.
nationalityQ: What is your nationality? It helps the authority work with your embassy if needed.
contactAbroadQ: How can the authority reach you after you fly? Type your e-mail or a WhatsApp number with the country code.
authConsentVisitor: Everything in the report file will be sent to the authority, except the screenshots: they stay with you. It also says you are a visitor, when you leave, and your nationality and contact if you gave them. The report is kept for {days} days only, then deleted automatically. No Emirates ID needed: confirm your identity with a UAE PASS visitor account, or with your passport.
passportVerify: No UAE PASS: confirm with my passport
visitorSent: 🧳 You are visiting: the report will be suggested for the Tourism Police, who follow it even after you leave the UAE. Keep the report number for your travel insurance.
minorHandoff: Thank you for speaking up. It is not your fault: the person threatening or hurting you is. To protect you, your report is handled by the Child Protection Centre's specialists, in full confidence, even if you can't tell your family. Your report file is ready: give it to them or to your parent.
childMoi: Child Protection Centre - Ministry of Interior (and the Hemayati app)
childMoe: Child Protection Unit - Ministry of Education
noPrivateImages: 🔒 Don't attach any private photo of yourself. Screenshot only the person's account and the threats.
parentSends: My parent will send it now
parentNote: Your parent continues from here and confirms their own identity.
